CREATE TABLE "public"."erp_audit_logs" (
  "action" text NOT NULL,
  "actorId" uuid,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "entityId" text,
  "entityType" text,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "ip" text,
  "metadata" text,
  "requestId" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."erp_customers" (
  "code" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" text,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "phone" text,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'ACTIVE' NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."erp_permissions" (
  "action" text NOT NULL,
  "code" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "module" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."erp_products" (
  "category" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "productType" text NOT NULL,
  "sku" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'ACTIVE' NOT NULL,
  "unit" text NOT NULL,
  "unitPrice" numeric DEFAULT '0'::numeric NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "variant" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."erp_role_permissions" (
  "grantedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "permissionId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "roleId" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."erp_roles" (
  "code" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "isSystem" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'ACTIVE' NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "erp_roles_status_check_56c81764" CHECK ("status" IN ('ACTIVE', 'DISABLED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."erp_sales_order_lines" (
  "category" text,
  "customerReference" text,
  "discountPercent" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "isCustom" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "lineTotal" numeric NOT NULL,
  "notes" text,
  "productId" uuid,
  "productName" text NOT NULL,
  "quantity" numeric NOT NULL,
  "salesOrderId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "skuReference" text,
  "taxPercent" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "unit" text NOT NULL,
  "unitPrice" numeric NOT NULL,
  "variant" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."erp_sales_orders" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "createdBy" uuid NOT NULL,
  "customerId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "deliveryDate" text,
  "discountTotal" numeric DEFAULT '0'::numeric NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "notes" text,
  "orderDate" text NOT NULL,
  "orderNumber" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'DRAFT' NOT NULL,
  "subtotal" numeric DEFAULT '0'::numeric NOT NULL,
  "taxTotal" numeric DEFAULT '0'::numeric NOT NULL,
  "totalAmount" numeric DEFAULT '0'::numeric NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."erp_user_roles" (
  "grantedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "roleId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "userId" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."erp_user_sessions" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "expiresAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "ip" text,
  "lastUsedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "revokedAt" timestamptz,
  "revokedBy" uuid,
  "tokenHash" text NOT NULL,
  "userAgent" text,
  "userId" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."erp_users" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" text NOT NULL,
  "employeeCode" text NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "lastLoginAt" timestamptz,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "passwordHash" text NOT NULL,
  "phone" text,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'ACTIVE' NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "erp_users_status_check_56c81764" CHECK ("status" IN ('ACTIVE', 'DISABLED'))
)
